scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "./.venv/bin/python app.py" "pnpm --dir web dev -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3000"
scripts.prestart: pnpm run setup:api && pnpm --dir web build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "./.venv/bin/python app.py" "pnpm --dir web start -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3000"
